notes: Working without raw FHL SN tags - used Hebrew lexicon knowledge to reconstruct SN assignments. Morphology codes (WTH8799 for wayyiqtol 說, WTH8317 for qal imperfect 滋生, WTH8787 for polel participle 飛) are approximate without the actual FHL data.
LCC 無數的 corresponds to UNV 多多 which is part of the H8317 verbal sense (teem abundantly) rather than a separate SN.

LCC 天穹 = UNV 天空 → H7549 (רָקִיעַ, firmament); H8064 (הַשָּׁמָיִם) kept as implicit {<WH8064>} since LCC has no explicit word for 'heavens' separate from 天穹.
H6440 (פְּנֵי, face/surface) mapped to 之中 — both serve as relational markers.
